d14_chart.source: easy-OTP/tools/transit_charts, chart D14 (segment speed by segment and hour), subprocess, no import (GPL)

note: Different aggregation on purpose: D14 grids by stop_sequence x time bucket with a min_n floor and reports a per-bucket median-ish speed; ti's number is Sigma L / Sigma T (docs/03 W1). Agreement in order of magnitude, no absurd values (>60 km/h) - that is the cross-check this criterion asks for, not an exact match of two different statistics.
